entries.description:
Déjà Vu
While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, gain 4 of Film Roll for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, gain 1 of Zoom for 30s. Max 1 stack, which is removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.
Film Roll
When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts Glacio Chafe onto the target, Lucilla consumes 1 of Film Roll to inflict Glacio Chafe 2 on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
Zoom
Each stack of Zoom increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%.
Oblivion
During Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, Lucilla consumes 1 Photo intermittently to perform Oblivion, dealing 1 instance of Glacio DMG:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, this instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. The skill inflicts 1 of Glacio Chafe on the target.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, this instance of DMG is considered Echo Skill DMG. Each cast of Oblivion is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.
Quick Glance
Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.
Trace
Lucilla can hold up to 150 points of Trace.
Restore 100 of Trace while casting Intro Skill - Clip It.
Restore 50 of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight.
Restore 50 of Trace while casting Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Restore 25 of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Compensate or Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable.
Photos
Lucilla can hold up to 3 Photos.
Every 50 of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.
